```python
Function(name: str, input_types: tuple[ValueType, ...], region: Region, metadata: dict[str, Any] = dict(), parent: Optional['Module'] = None)
```

Part of [`evoxc.ir`](/api/evoxc/ir/)

A named function: typed signature + one region.

## Attributes

- `name` · `str` — Function name (unique within the `Module`; "main" is the v1
  convention for traced graphs).

- `input_types` · `tuple[ValueType, ...]` — Parameter types; the region's entry-block arguments must
  match exactly (verified).

- `region` · `Region` — The function body region (single-block in v1).

- `metadata` · `dict[str, Any]` — Free-form JSON-able annotations (e.g. static-value notes).

- `parent` · `Optional['Module']` — The owning `Module`, or None.

## entry_block

The function body's (single) block.

## output_types

The output signature, read off the `return` terminator.

### Raises

- `ValueError` — If the entry block has no terminator.
